# Phase 1a example: pure Int/Bool functions with contracts and tests.

fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  req n >= 0
  ens r >= 1
= if n <= 1 then 1 else n * fact(n - 1)

fn gcd(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  req a >= 0 && b >= 0
= if b == 0 then a else gcd(b, a % b)

fn is_prime(n: Int) -> Bool = n >= 2 && no_divisor(n, 2)

fn no_divisor(n: Int, d: Int) -> Bool = if d * d > n then true else n % d != 0 && no_divisor(n, d + 1)

fn withoutHead(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int] =

  if len(xs) <= 1 then xs

       let rest = withoutHead(xs) in
       sortIt(filter(rest, fn(y: Int) => y < p)) ++ [p] ++ sortIt(filter(rest, fn(y: Int) => y >= p))
